mapper.sql: s.segment_id, s.name, s.description, r.rule_json::text AS rule_json, s.created_by, s.created_at, s.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO segment (name, description, created_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{createdBy})
INSERT INTO segment_rule (segment_id, rule_json) VALUES (#{segmentId}, CAST(#{ruleJson} AS jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM segment s JOIN segment_rule r ON r.segment_id = s.segment_id ORDER BY s.segment_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE segment SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, updated_at = now() WHERE segment_id = #{segmentId}
UPDATE segment_rule SET rule_json = CAST(#{ruleJson} AS jsonb), updated_at = now() WHERE segment_id = #{segmentId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign WHERE segment_id = #{segmentId})
SELECT customer_id FROM customer ORDER BY customer_id

SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE email_consent_yn = 'Y') AS email_consent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sms_consent_yn = 'Y') AS sms_consent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE dormant_yn = 'Y') AS dormant FROM customer
